title: About Samir Akhalil
text:
Samir Akhalil – M.Sc. Engineering Student | AI & Machine Learning
Location: Karlskrona, Sweden
Building intelligent systems and solving real-world problems through software engineering and artificial intelligence.
I'm an M.Sc. Engineering student in AI and Machine Learning at Blekinge Institute of Technology, graduating in 2027. I have hands-on experience applying AI and machine learning to real data from industry and the public sector.
Right now I'm part of a student team building an AI agent for Trafikverket that triages production alerts, running on self-hosted language models so that no operational data leaves the organisation's network. I also work on classifying building and energy sensors from more than 7.5 million time-series measurements at Axiogreen.
I'm looking for a master's thesis in AI for spring 2027.

title: AI Engineering Student – Incident-Triage Agent at Trafikverket (Swedish Transport Administration)
text:
Experience: AI Engineering Student – Incident-Triage Agent at Trafikverket (Swedish Transport Administration)
Kind of engagement: Ten-person student team, via BTH
Period: Sep 2026 – Jan 2027
Ten-person student team building an AI agent that triages production alerts for Trafikverket's operations teams.
Designing an agent that reads the metrics, logs and source code behind an alert and proposes a diagnosis with next steps, so on-call engineers start from a hypothesis instead of a blank page.
Building it on self-hosted LLMs (Gemma) with a tool-calling agent loop, so no operational data leaves the organisation's network.
Integrating with Grafana, Prometheus and Kubernetes through a Python backend.
Technologies: Python, Self-hosted LLMs (Gemma), Grafana, Prometheus, Kubernetes

title: Machine Learning Intern – Sensor Classification at Axiogreen
text:
Experience: Machine Learning Intern – Sensor Classification at Axiogreen
Kind of engagement: Internship
Period: 2026 – Present
Classifying building and energy sensor types from metadata and time-series measurements.
Mapped PostgreSQL tables of sensors, devices, locations and measurement history and standardised inconsistent names, categories, units, labels, thresholds and multipliers.
Analysed more than 7.5 million time-series records from about 130 sensors for missing values, anomalies, value ranges, sampling frequencies and data gaps, and documented the workflow in Jupyter notebooks and Markdown reports.
Technologies: SQL, PostgreSQL, Jupyter

title: Full-Stack Developer – Access-Control System at Ericsson
text:
Experience: Full-Stack Developer – Access-Control System at Ericsson
Kind of engagement: Client project via BTH, student team
Period: 2025 – 2026
Student team delivering an access-control system for shared Windows computers to Ericsson's requirements.
Built the Flask administration platform (SQLAlchemy, REST-style routes) for users, access schedules, account expiry, temporary access codes and login history.
Implemented schedule-based authorisation that checks account status, expiry, weekday and permitted time windows before granting access.
Connected the platform and Microsoft SQL Server to a C# Windows Forms lock-screen application handling card-based login, session control and audit logging.
Technologies: Flask, SQLAlchemy, Microsoft SQL Server, C#
